completion:
Understand the limitations of the monitoring.
3. Complete the missing data.
4. Estimate the hidden emissions.
5. Clean up the air.

## The report
In the [complaint report](~/document/complaint/complaint-airquality.md) I reported the following five excessive odour emissions from the two odour sources at the landfill:
- 8:00h: 15 out of 15 on-waste odours (odour strength 4 out of 4), blowing across the residential property.
- 10:00h: 4 out of 4 on-waste odours (odour strength 3 out of 4), blowing across the residential property.
- 12:00h: 5 out of 5 on-waste odours (odour strength 3 out of 4), blowing towards the residential property.
